title: Kula Today
heading: Today · Mon 09 Nov
summary: A flat day (forecast light). Thermals stayed light all day. The upslope ran from about 09:15 to about 16:15. The evening before, the page called it normal, about 5,000 ft, a hit. Midday the base averaged about 5,100 ft by the Kekoa camera, 100 ft higher than the evening's number; the morning update said about 5,400 ft, off by 300 ft. Most of the day the shear line was crossing Kula Highway near Kamehameha Schools; furthest north about 13:54, at Pukalani, running toward Kahului; furthest south about 09:37, crossing Kula Highway near Omaopio. Data gaps: no readings all day from 3 stations (Kahikinui, Nakula, Upper Kahikinui); the Mesonet could not be reached on 10 of 50 updates.
